verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.sm: SA i le tasi mea o ia, ua tatalo, ua uma, ona fai mai lea ia te ia o le tasi o lona au soo, Le Alii e, ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te i matou i tatalo ; e faapei o Ioane foi ona a‘oa‘o i ona soo.

verses.en: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou, Pe a outou tatalo, ia outou fai atu, Lo matou Tamā e o i le lagi, ia paia lou suafa. la oo mai lou malo. la faia lou finagalo i le lalolagi, e pei ona faia i le lagi.

verses.en: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.sm: la e foai mai ia te i matou i lea aso ma lea aso a matou mea e ‘ai e tatau ma le aso.

verses.en: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.sm: Ia e faamagalo ia te i matou i a matou agasala; auā foi matou te faamagaloina atu ia i latou uma o e agaleaga mai ia te i matou. Aua foi e te taitaiina i matou i le tofotofoga ; a ia e laveai mai ia i matou ai le leaga.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, O ai so outou e ana le uo, e alu atu ia te ia i le tulua o po, ma fai atu ia te ia, Sole, se‘i au mai ni areto e tolu gafua, a e taui atu;

verses.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
verses.sm: auā ua sau la‘u uo ia te au i lana malaga, a e leai ni a‘u mea e laulau atu i ai;

verses.en: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
verses.sm: e tali mai o ia mai totonu o le fale, ua faapea mai, Aua e te faasoesa mai ia te au; ua uma ona pupuni o le faitotoa, ua matou taooto ma la‘u fanau; ou te le mafai ona tulai e avatu mā oe.

verses.en: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E ui lava ina le tulai o ia, ma avatu ia te ia, ona o ia o lana uo, a e tulai, ma avatu mea uma e manao ai o ia, ona o lana faatauanau ane.

verses.en: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi a‘u ia te outou, la outou ole atu, ona foaiina mai ai lea ia te outou ; ia outou saili, ona outou maua ai lea; ia outou tu‘itu‘i atu, ona toina mai ai lea ia te outou.

verses.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.sm: Auā ai se ole atu, e maua e ia; o le saili, e iloa e ia; o le tu‘itu‘i,e toina mai ia te ia.

verses.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.sm: O ai se tamā ia te outou e avatu ea e ia i lona atalii se maa, pe a ole mai se areto ? pe a ole mai se i‘a, e avatu ea ia te ia se gata a e le o se i‘a ?

verses.en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.sm: pe a ole mai se fuāmoa, e avatu ea ia te ia se akarava?

verses.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.sm: O lenei, o outou e leaga, afai ua iloa e outou ona avatu o mea lelei mā a outou fanau; e le sili ea ona foaiina Agaga Paia i e ole atu ai ia te ia ?

verses.en: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.sm: Sa tuli e ia le temoni, ua gūgū foi o ia; ua alu i fafo le temoni, ona gagana ai lea o le gūgū ua ofo ai lava le motu o tagata.

verses.en: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
verses.sm: Peitai o isi o i latou ua fai ane, O Pelesepulo le alii o temoni, ua tuiia ai e ia o temoni.

verses.en: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.sm: O isi foi ua faaosooso, ua saili mai ia te ia se faailoga mai le lagi.

verses.en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
verses.sm: A ua silafia e ia o iatou manatu, ona fetalai atu lea ia te i latou, O malo uma e fevaevaeai, e faaumatia ia; po o se aiga e fevaevaeai, e malaia lea.

verses.en: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.sm: Afai foi e fevaevaeai Satani, pe faapefea ea ona tumau o lona malo ? auā ua outou fai mai, o Pelesepulo e tulia ai e a‘u o temoni.

verses.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.sm: Afai o Pelesepulo e tulia ai e a‘u o temoni, ia, po ai e tulia ai temoni e a outou fanau ? o lea, e fai ai i latou ma faamasino ia te outou.

verses.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
verses.sm: A e afai o le aao o le Atua ou te tulia ai temoni, ua oo mai lava ia te outou le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.sm: A leoleoina e le tagata malosi ma lana auupega lona fale, ona saogalemu ai lea o ana mea.

verses.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.sm: A e afai e oso atu ia te ia le tasi e sili lona malosi ia te ia, ua manumalo i ai, ona fao ai lea o lana auupega uma na ia faatuatua i ai, ma tufatufa i ana mea na fao.

verses.en: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.sm: O se le ‘au ia te au, e ‘au ese lea ia te au ; o se le faaputu faatasi ma a‘u, e faataapeape lea.

verses.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.sm: Pe a alu le agaga leaga i fafo o le tagata, ua fealualuai ia i mea matutu, ua saili se mapusaga, a e le maua ; ona fai ane lea, Ou te toe foi i lo‘u fale na ou sau ai.

verses.en: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
verses.sm: Ua oo i ai, ona iloa ai lea, ua uma ona tafitafi ma teuteu.

verses.en: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia, ua na aumaia isi agaga e toafitu, e sili lo latou leaga i lona; ona latou ulufale ai lea, ua nonofo ai; ona sili ai lea o Je leaga o le iuga o lea tagata i lona amataga.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai ane ia i nei mea, a ua alaga tele mai ai le tasi fafine mai le motu o tagata, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Amuia le manava na fanau mai ai oe, ma susu na e susu ai.

verses.en: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu ia, E moni, a e sili ona manuia o e faalogo i le afioga a le Atua, ma tausi i ai.

verses.en: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.sm: Ua lolofi mai le motu o tagata, ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia, O le tupulaga leaga lenei, ua saili mai se faailoga, a e le avatu i ai se faailoga, tau lava o le faailoga o Iona le perofeta.

verses.en: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.sm: Auā pei o Iona ona fai ma faailoga ia Nineva, e faapea foi le Atalii o le tagata i le tupulaga nei.

verses.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.sm: O le tupu fafine o le itu i toga e tulai o ia i le faamasinoga ma tagata o le tupulaga nei, e faasala foi o ia ia te i latou; auā na sau ia mai le gataaga o le lalolagi e faalogo i le poto o Solomona ; faauta foi, o iinei lava le sili ia Solomona.

verses.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.sm: E tutū tagata o Nineva i le faamasinoga faatasi ma le tupulaga nei, e faasala i ai; auā na latou salamo i le talaiga a lona; faauta foi, o iinei lava le sili ia Iona.

verses.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.sm: E leai se tūtū i le lamepa, ma tuu i le mea lilo, po o i lalo o le mea e fua a‘i saito, a e tuu i luga lava o le tuugālamepa, ina ia iloa mai ai le malamalam i i e ulufale m?ū.

verses.en: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
verses.sm: O mata, o le lamepa lea o le tino ; o lenei, pe afai ua lelei ou mata, e malamalama uma ai lou tino; a e afai ua leaga, e pouliuli ai lou tino.

verses.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia oe, ne‘i pogisa le malamalama ua i totonu ia te oe.

verses.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua malamalama lou tino uma, e leai sona pouliuli, e malamalama uma ai, pei ona faamalamalama mai ia te oe o le lamepa i lona pupula mai.

verses.en: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai o ia, a e fai mai le tasi faresaio ia te ia, la te aai ma ia; ona ulufale lea o ia, ua taoto e taumafa.

verses.en: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le faresaio, ona ofo lava lea iā ua le muai mulumulu ia, i le ‘ai ai.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu le Alii ia te ia, Outou faresaio, ua faamamaina lava e outou le tua o le ipu ma le tanoa, peitai o totonu o outou ua tutumu i mea ua faoa ma le amio leaga.

verses.en: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.sm: Outou na o valea! o le na faia le tua, e lei faia ea foi e ia o totonu?

verses.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.sm: A ia outou avatu a outou mea e fai ma mea alofa; faauta foi, e mamā ai mea uma ia te outou.

verses.en: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.sm: Oi talofa foi ia te outou faresaio ! auā tou te avatu mea e sefulu a‘i le mili, ma le pekano, ma laau uma e afu, a ua tuua e outou le faamasinoga ma le alofa i le Atua ; e tatau pe ana faia nei mea, a e aua foi le tou na mea.

verses.en: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou faresaio! auā ua mananao outou i nofoa sili i sunako, ma ia I alofaina i malae,

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata pepelo ! auā tou te tutusa ma tuugamau e lilo; o tagata foi o e ua savavali i o latou luga, ua le iloa e i latou.

verses.en: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tasi o le au a‘oa‘o tulafono, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Le a‘oa‘o e, ua e faaleaga mai ia te i matou i lau e fai mai na.

verses.en: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia, Oi talofa ia te outou foi le au a‘oa‘o tulafono! auā ua faaee atu e outou avega mamafa i tagata, a o outou, tou te le tago lava i na avega i so outou tamatamai lima.

verses.en: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou ! auā ua outou ati ae tuugamau o perofeta; o outou tamā foi, na latou fasioti ia te i latou.

verses.en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
verses.sm: Ua molimau lava outou i le amio a o outou tamā, ma fiafia i ai; auā na latou fasioti ia te i latou, a e tou te ati ae o latou tuugamau.

verses.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.sm: O lea foi ua fetalai mai ai le poto o le Atua, Ou te aauina atu ia te i latou perofeta ma aposetolo ; e fasioti foi e i latou, ma faasaua i nisi;

verses.en: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.sm: ina ia suea i le tupulaga nei le toto o perofeta uma ua faamaligiina talu ona faavaeina o le lalolagi;

verses.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.sm: e afua mai i le tōto o Apelu, e oo atu i le toto o Sakaria, na fasiotia i le va o le fata faitaulaga ma le malumalu; e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e suea lava ia i lenei tupulaga.

verses.en: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou le au a‘oa‘o tulafono! auā ua avea e outou le ki o le malamalama; tou te le ulu atu ai, tou te vavao foi i e a ulu atu.

verses.en: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia i ia upu ia te i latou, ona matuā ita lea o le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio ; oiia latou fesili faaosooso lea ia te ia i mea e tele,

verses.en: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
verses.sm: o lamalama ia te ia, ma saili e taofi i se upu mai lona fofoga, ina ia latou momoli ia te ia. Ua apoapoai Tesu i ona soo ina ia
